nodes.title: Extensions of PSL have a new element order

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every $n \ge 3$, every prime $p$ and every $k \ge 1$, with $q = p^k$ and $\mathbb{F}_q$ the field with $q$ elements, the following holds: whenever $H$ is a nontrivial normal subgroup of a finite group $G$ and $G/H$ is isomorphic to the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$, some element of $G$ has an order that is not the order of any element of $G/H$.
nodes.title: Kourovka 14.60: new element orders in extensions of projective special linear groups

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and a field $F$, $\mathrm{PSL}_n(F)$ is the quotient $\mathrm{SL}_n(F)/Z(\mathrm{SL}_n(F))$ of the special linear group $\mathrm{SL}_n(F)$ of $n \times n$ matrices over $F$ with determinant $1$ by its centre.
